title: Filtered homotopies induce equal page maps from the second page
statement: Under the bounded filtered-complex and filtration-shift hypotheses of lem-sp-filtered-homotopy-spectral-sequence, every FilteredPageTwoModel sends the two homotopic filtered maps to equal spectral-sequence morphisms.

source.place: Lemma 012O (homology-lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex-functorial) together with Definition 012U (homology-definition-filtered-complex-ss-converges), applied to the filtered-complex homotopy calculation

proof.text: Use the model naturality data to identify each page map with the map on the image of H(F^p/F^(p+r)) → H(F^(p-r+1)/F^(p+1)). No construction or convergence theorem is needed because the model supplies these identifications.

Convert the degreewise-image factorizations of the homotopy into maps from the actual filtration steps F^p to G^(p-1). Include G^(p-1) into G^(p-r+1), valid for r ≥ 2. Cancel the monic step inclusions in the ambient homotopy identity to obtain a homotopy between the two step maps F^p → G^(p-r+1).

On F^(p+r), this homotopy factors through G^(p+r-1) and hence G^(p+1). It vanishes after the target quotient. Evaluation preserves cokernels, so the componentwise cokernel universal property descends the homotopy to F^p/F^(p+r) → G^(p-r+1)/G^(p+1). Naturality and the quotient projection equations identify its endpoints with φ followed by the two induced quotient maps.

Apply Mathlib Homotopy.homologyMap_eq to the descended homotopy. Cancel the epimorphism onto the homology image, then use page naturality and cancel the monic image inclusion and page isomorphism. Extensionality over bidegrees and pages gives equality of spectral-sequence morphisms.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 012O and the quotient-complex image description of Section 012K; homotopy descended through degreewise cokernels (C3).

theorem filteredHomotopy_page_map_eq
    (K L : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (G : DecreasingFiltration L)
    (hKF : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ pmin : ℤ, ∃ pmax : ℤ,
      F.complexStep pmin n = ⊤ ∧ F.complexStep pmax n = ⊥)
    (hLG : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ pmin : ℤ, ∃ pmax : ℤ,
      G.complexStep pmin n = ⊤ ∧ G.complexStep pmax n = ⊥)
    (a b : FilteredObject.Hom ⟨K, F⟩ ⟨L, G⟩)
    (H : Homotopy a.hom b.hom)
    (hshift : ∀ (p n : ℤ), ∃ ℓ :
      (F.complexStep p n : C) ⟶ (G.complexStep (p - 1) (n - 1) : C),
      ℓ ≫ (G.complexStep (p - 1) (n - 1)).arrow =
        (F.complexStep p n).arrow ≫ H.hom n (n - 1)) :
    ∀ (M : FilteredPageTwoModel C), M.S.map a = M.S.map b
